+sceneWithFileNamed:.doc: Loads the specified SpriteKit scene file, creating a GKScene object containing the SpriteKit scene and associated GameplayKit objects.

-addEntity:.doc: Adds a GameplayKit entity to the list of entities managed by the scene.

-removeEntity:.doc: Removes a GameplayKit entity from the list of entities managed by the scene.

-removeGraph:.doc: Removes a pathfinding graph from the list of graphs managed by the scene.

+obstacleWithRadius:.doc: Creates a spherical obstacle with the specified radius.

-initWithRadius:.doc: Initializes a spherical obstacle with the specified radius.

+spheresNoiseWithFrequency:.doc: Creates a sphere noise source with the specified frequency.

-initWithFrequency:.doc: Initializes a sphere noise source with the specified frequency.

+state.doc: Creates a state object with the specified list of valid next states.

-didEnterWithPreviousState:.doc: Performs custom actions when a state machine transitions into this state.

-isValidNextState:.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether a state machine currently in this state is allowed to transition into the specified state.

-updateWithDeltaTime:.doc: Performs custom actions when a state machine updates while in this state.

-willExitWithNextState:.doc: Performs custom actions when a state machine transitions out of this state.

+stateMachineWithStates:.doc: Creates a state machine with the specified states.

-canEnterState:.doc: Returns a Boolean value indicating whether it is valid for the state machine to transition from its current state to a state of the specified class.

-enterState:.doc: Attempts to transition the state machine from its current state to a state of the specified class.

-initWithStates:.doc: Initializes a state machine with the specified states.

-stateForClass:.doc: Returns the state object in the state machine corresponding to the specified class.

-updateWithDeltaTime:.doc: Tells the current state object to perform per-frame updates.

+voronoiNoiseWithFrequency:displacement:.doc: Creates a Voronoi noise source with the specified parameters.

-initWithFrequency:displacement:distance.doc: Initializes a Voronoi noise source with the specified parameters.

seed.doc: The seed data that determines the random source’s behavior.

behavior.doc: A weighted collection of goals that influence the agent’s movement.

delegate.doc: An object that prepares for or responds to updates in the agent simulation.

mass.doc: The resistance of the agent to changes in speed or direction.

maxAcceleration.doc: The upper limit to changes in the agent’s speed or direction.

maxSpeed.doc: The agent’s maximum forward speed, in units per second.

speed.doc: The agent’s current forward speed, in units per second.

position.doc: The current position of the agent in 2D space.

rotation.doc: The rotation of the agent around the z-axis.

velocity.doc: The current velocity of the agent in 2D space.

position.doc: The current position of the agent in 3D space.

rotation.doc: The orientation of the agent in 3D space.

velocity.doc: The current velocity of the agent in 3D space.

goalCount.doc: The number of goals in the behavior.

persistence.doc: The rate at which successive octaves of the noise function decrease in amplitude.

squareSize.doc: The size (both width and height) of squares in the generated checkerboard pattern.

frequency.doc: A value that determines the size and spacing of features in generated noise.

lacunarity.doc: The rate at which successive octaves of the noise function increase in frequency.

octaveCount.doc: The number of octaves of the underlying noise function to use for generating noise.

seed.doc: The value that determines the specific configuration of noise produced by the noise source.

entity.doc: The entity that owns this component.

componentClass.doc: The class of components managed by the component system.

components.doc: The component system’s list of components.

behaviorCount.doc: The number of individual behaviors in the composite behavior.

value.doc: The constant value for the generated noise.

frequency.doc: A value that determines the size and spacing of concentric cylinders.

randomSource.doc: The randomizer to be used when evaluating parts of the tree that branch randomly.

rootNode.doc: The decision node at the root of the decision tree, representing the first attribute to test.

deviation.doc: The standard deviation of the distribution (also called sigma).

mean.doc: The mean value of the distribution (also called the expected value or median).

nodes.doc: The list of nodes in the graph.

connectedNodes.doc: The list of other nodes connected to this node.

position.doc: The position of the node in continuous 2D space.
The position of the node in continuous 2D space.

diagonalsAllowed.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether nodes in the grid are connected to their diagonal neighbors.

gridHeight.doc: The number of possible y-coordinates in the grid.

gridOrigin.doc: The lowest x- and y-coordinates that appear in the grid.

gridWidth.doc: The number of possible x-coordinates in the grid.

gridPosition.doc: The position of the node on a discrete integer grid.

seed.doc: The seed value that determines the random source’s behavior.
The seed value that determines the random source’s behavior.

bufferRadius.doc: The distance from obstacle edges that should also be considered impassable.

obstacles.doc: The list of obstacle objects in the graph, each of which describes a polygon-shaped impassable area.

triangleCount.doc: The number of triangles in the mesh.

triangulationMode.doc: A set of options for how to place graph nodes when triangulating the graph.

maxLookAheadDepth.doc: The number of future turns for the strategist to consider when planning moves.

budget.doc: The maximum number of game model states the strategist will examine when searching for a move.

explorationParameter.doc: A value that influences whether the strategist searches more broadly or more deeply for winning game model states.

predicate.doc: A predicate to be tested when evaluating the rule.

gradientColors.doc: A dictionary mapping noise values to colors for use in colorizing generated noise.

origin.doc: The position of the “slice” of noise samples contained in the noise map relative to the unit coordinate space of the noise object it was created from.

sampleCount.doc: The width and height of integer grid for which the noise map contains sampled noise values.

seamless.doc: A Boolean value indicating whether the noise map’s output can repeat seamlessly in all directions.

size.doc: The size of the “slice” of noise samples contained in the noise map relative to the unit coordinate space of the noise object it was created from.

bufferRadius.doc: The distance from obstacle edges that should also be considered impassable.

obstacles.doc: The list of obstacle objects in the graph, each of which describes a polygon-shaped impassable area.

box.doc: The axis-aligned bounding box represented by the node.

cyclical.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the path loops around on itself (that is, the path’s end point connects to its start point).

numPoints.doc: The number of vertices in the path.

persistence.doc: The rate at which successive octaves of the noise function decrease in amplitude.

vertexCount.doc: The number of vertices that define the polygon-shaped area of the obstacle.

quad.doc: The axis-aligned bounding rectangle represented by the node.

queryReserve.doc: The number of elements to reserve space for when searching.

highestValue.doc: The highest value to be produced by the distribution.

lowestValue.doc: The lowest value to be produced by the distribution.

numberOfPossibleOutcomes.doc: The number of unique values the distribution can generate.

salience.doc: The importance of the rule relative to others in a rule system’s agenda.

agenda.doc: The list of rules to be considered when evaluating the system.

executed.doc: The list of rules whose actions have been performed during evaluation of the system.

facts.doc: The list of facts claimed by the rule system.

rules.doc: The list of rules to be executed when evaluating the system.

state.doc: A dictionary of state information to be evaluated by the system’s rules.

node.doc: The SpriteKit node managed by the component.

entities.doc: The list of GameplayKit entities managed by the scene.

graphs.doc: The list of pathfinding graph objects managed by the scene.

rootNode.doc: The SpriteKit scene managed by this GKScene object.

frequency.doc: A value that determines the size and spacing of concentric spheres.

stateMachine.doc: The state machine that owns this state object.

displacement.doc: The range of random values to assign to each cell in generated noise.

distanceEnabled.doc: A Boolean value that specifies whether generated noise values incorporate the distance from each point to the nearest seed point.

frequency.doc: A value that determines the number and size of cells in generated noise.

seed.doc: The value that determines the specific configuration of noise produced by the noise source.
